what: Mistake: merged PR #149 by hand around athena land (squash 02837e0, 2026-10-18), folding two hand fixes into a job's landing; main's history check went red, a revert and an exemption followed, and two verified jobs were stranded.
why: Athena's land should judge the pull request's current head, and refuse a head that holds anything beyond the job's landing commit, so that nobody needs to merge around it.
